title: mirabilis jalapa var. lindheimeri
intro: Mirabilis jalapa var. lindheimeri, commonly known as the Lindheimer's four o'clock, is a plant species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis jalapa var. lindheimeri include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
